title: Facial attractiveness and profile-based perceived orthognathic surgery need: comparative assessment among professionals, laypersons, and artificial intelligence models
html: This study evaluated the effect of controlled 2° sagittal profile modifications on facial attractiveness ratings and profile-based perceived orthognathic surgery need using one standardized female and one standardized male facial model. For each model, nine digitally manipulated profile images were generated from −8° to +8° relative to baseline and assessed by orthodontists, oral and maxillofacial surgeons (OMFS), and laypersons (n = 72). Two multimodal artificial intelligence systems, ChatGPT-4.0 and Gemini 1.5 Pro, independently generated attractiveness scores to provide an exploratory benchmark for human–AI agreement.
